info.name: Participium
info.description: Acceptance test suite for the Participium backend API. Run top-to-bottom against a locally started backend (see src/backend/README.md). Requires seed demo data (BOOTSTRAP_DEMO_DATA=true). Use Newman: newman run Participium.postman_collection.json -e Participium.postman_environment.json --working-dir .
